sumInsured.title: Sum Insured
sumInsured.description: The most your policy pays, subject to its terms.

coPayment.title: Co-payment
coPayment.description: A co-payment applies, but the percentage isn't stated in your policy details.
coPayment.wording: Applied on the admissible claim amount.

deductible.title: Deductible
deductible.description: Your policy details don't mention a deductible.

periods.title: Initial waiting period
periods.description: Illness claims are not paid during this time from the start of cover.

periods.title: Pre-existing diseases
periods.description: Illnesses you had before buying the policy are covered only after this time.
periods.wording: Any condition, ailment, injury or disease diagnosed by a physician not more than 36 months prior to the date of commencement of the policy, or for which medical advice or treatment was recommended/received. Covered after 36 months of continuous coverage.

waitingPeriods.basis: Based on your inputs, this policy was first taken on 01-Jun-2019 and renewed every year without a break
notes: All waiting periods have been completed

roomRent.title: Room rent
roomRent.description: No cap on the room category you choose.
roomRent.wording: Any room category up to Sum Insured (no room rent capping)

limits.title: ICU charges
limits.description: Actuals up to Sum Insured, including nursing and monitoring charges
limits.wording: Actuals up to Sum Insured, including nursing and monitoring charges.

limits.title: Modern treatments
limits.description: Robotic surgery, immunotherapy and similar advanced treatments.

additionalBenefits.title: Before hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Tests and medicines up to 60 days before admission.

additionalBenefits.title: After hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Follow-up costs up to 180 days after discharge.

additionalBenefits.title: Daycare procedures
additionalBenefits.description: Treatments that need less than 24 hours in hospital.
additionalBenefits.wording: All day care procedures listed in the Annexure.

additionalBenefits.title: Ambulance
additionalBenefits.description: Road ambulance up to ₹5,000 per hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.wording: Road ambulance up to Rs. 5,000 per hospitalisation.

additionalBenefits.title: Cashless hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: At network hospitals, the insurer pays the hospital directly.
additionalBenefits.wording: Cashless at network hospitals or reimbursement.

additionalBenefits.title: In-patient hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Needs at least 24 hours in hospital.
additionalBenefits.wording: Minimum 24 hours admission required (except for specified procedures/treatments).

additionalBenefits.title: AYUSH treatment
additionalBenefits.description: Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy treatment.

additionalBenefits.title: Organ donor expenses
additionalBenefits.description: Costs of the organ donor's surgery.

additionalBenefits.title: Restoration benefit
additionalBenefits.description: Sum insured is refilled after it is used up.

special: Notice with full particulars shall be sent to the Company / TPA within 24 hours of admission in case of emergency hospitalisation and at least 48 hours prior to admission in case of planned hospitalisation
Continuous coverage since 01-Jun-2019 with the Company; policy renewed every year without break in coverage
Non-medical items listed in Annexure I shall not be payable unless specifically stated as payable
exclusions: Pre-existing diseases and its direct complications until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with the Company (Code - Excl01)
War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, nuclear, chemical or biological contamination
Treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered (Code - Excl03)
Sterility and infertility, including contraception, assisted reproduction services, gestational surrogacy and reversal of sterilisation (Excl17)

Treatment of listed conditions, surgeries or treatments until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with the Company, except for claims arising due to an accident (Code - Excl02)
Breach of Law (Excl10): Expenses for treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent

Investigation and Evaluation (Excl04): Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded, and any diagnostic expenses which are not related or not incidental to current diagnosis and treatment are excluded
Substance Abuse (Excl12): Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof
Dental treatment unless requiring hospitalisation due to an accident

Obesity / Weight Control (Excl06): Expenses related to surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil the conditions specified (BMI of 40 or more, or 35 or more with severe co-morbidities, and failure of less invasive methods)

Hazardous or Adventure Sports (Excl09): Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports, including para-jumping, rock climbing, mountaineering, rafting, motor racing, horse racing, scuba diving and deep-sea diving
Change-of-Gender Treatments (Excl07): Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex

Cosmetic or Plastic Surgery (Excl08): Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an accident, burn(s) or cancer or as part of medically necessary treatment to remove a direct and immediate health risk to the insured. Aesthetic procedures including rhinoplasty, blepharoplasty, liposuction and abdominoplasty undertaken to improve appearance are not payable
Unproven Treatments (Excl16): Expenses related to any unproven treatment, services and supplies for or in connection with any treatment

Maternity (Excl18): Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalisation) except ectopic pregnancy, and expenses towards miscarriage or termination of pregnancy

Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care (Excl05): Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment, including custodial care and services for assistance with activities of daily living

Dietary Supplements (Excl14): Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription, including vitamins, minerals and organic substances, unless prescribed by a medical practitioner as part of hospitalisation

Wellness and Rejuvenation (Excl13): Treatments received in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas or similar establishments, or private beds registered as a nursing home attached to such establishments, or where admission is arranged wholly or partly for domestic reasons
Refractive Error (Excl15): Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres

Excluded Providers (Excl11): Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider specifically excluded by the Company and disclosed on its website, except in case of life threatening situations
